briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases with o4 and Grok-4 leading capability gains. Funding surges past $11B this quarter as compute constraints tighten. Regulatory focus remains fragmented while prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; xAI releases Grok-4 claiming parity on reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta Llama-4 variants push open-source performance. Google Gemini 3.0 preview shows gains in long-context handling.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities reported in agentic workflows. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level while prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST updates voluntary guidelines for frontier labs.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft and Google announce new 200k H100-equivalent clusters. Energy deals signed for dedicated nuclear restarts to power data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs outpace safety tooling before 2027?
